title: Just ok
text: Just ok. Am disappointed in this comforter set. The king size comforter is not large enough to cover the mattress and boxspring. The comforter fabric looks ok but isn't soft to the touch. Am sure it will shrink with the first washing as it's cotton. So this would be a good comforter for a guest room  but not so good for every day use. The comforter has a few tucks in it to look like a comforter however it just comes across as an unfinished product. The shams are good and the 2 extra pillows are very nice. However this just isn't a great Laura Ashley product. I've purchased her products before and they were excellent - good quality materials and well done. This is not one of those products.

product_metadata.title: Laura Ashley Home - Twin Size Comforter Set, Reversible Cotton Bedding, Includes Matching Sham with Bonus Euro Sham & Throw Pillows (Natalie Sage/Off White, Twin)
features: SET INCLUDES: (1) Twin comforter, (1) sham, (1) euro sham, and (2) throw pillows
FEATURES: Reversible to a coordinating pattern allowing for two different looks.
DIMENSIONS: Comforter: 86" x 63" Shams: 20" x 26" Euro Shams: 26" x 26" Throw Pillows: 12" x 16", 16" x 16"
CARE INSTRUCTIONS: Machine washable for easy care. Machine wash cold, separately. Delicate cycle. Tumble dry low. Do not bleach. Do not iron. Do not dry clean.
description: Jade green is a serenely beautiful color and it brings a lovely tranquility to this classic floral toile on a cream cotton ground. Coordinated with a crisp shirting stripe on the comforter reverse and European shams, this timeless classic fits easily into a modern bedroom. A floral embroidered accent pillow repeats the comforter design and lends a unique, customized detail to the ensemble.
